name: SiegeTeam - Default (seed v1)
description: A team of a siege scenario: role, alliance, identity (clan or ad hoc) and spawnpoints. Created from the scenario's Teams step.

steps.description: What the team does in the match and who its allies are.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: Filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: The first Defender team holds the objectives and owns the gates unless set otherwise.

fields.label: Alliance group
fields.description: Teams with the same number are allies; every other team is an enemy. A scenario needs at least two groups.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Position in the scenario's team list. Leave empty to add it after the existing teams.

steps.description: Name, colour and banner: take them from a clan, or give an ad-hoc team its own.

fields.label: Clan
fields.description: Take name, colour and banner from a clan (the town's default clan is listed first). Leave empty for an ad-hoc team.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Required without a clan; with a clan it replaces the clan's name in this scenario.

fields.label: Chat colour
fields.description: Required without a clan; with a clan it replaces the clan's colour.

fields.label: Banner
fields.description: Required without a clan; with a clan it replaces the clan's banner.

fields.label: Start message
fields.description: Optional action-bar message for this team when the match starts.

steps.description: Every team needs at least one spawnpoint. Save the team first (Submit), then Edit it again to add spawnpoints.

fields.label: Spawnpoints
fields.description: Create New opens the spawnpoint form; capture each spot in game.
